title: Client Advocacy Harvester I/O
description: Input/output contract for function 26. Harvests an approved Fireflies transcript excerpt into a client-advocacy/testimonial intake record, gated on BOTH a local consent-register fixture (modeling contracts/vault-schema/schema.sql's consent_register table shape — there is no live Vault API in this repo) and docs/permission-register.yaml client-naming clearance. Output is a decision record, not a publishable asset.

client_reference.description: The client, prospect or reference name the caller wants to attribute the quote to. Checked against docs/permission-register.yaml with default-deny semantics before it may ever be surfaced in output.

proposed_quote.description: The approved Fireflies transcript excerpt or testimonial text proposed for harvesting.

channel.description: Where the harvested advocacy record is destined to be used.

pillar.description: Optional messaging pillar to tag the harvested record with, for downstream drafting functions.

consent_record.description: Local consent-register FIXTURE row modeling contracts/vault-schema/schema.sql's consent_register table shape (data_subject_ref, channel, purpose, consented_at, revoked_at). There is no live Vault API reachable from this function; every eval task supplies this fixture directly in its own input rather than the function fetching it from a live service.

client_named.description: True only when BOTH the consent fixture is active (revoked_at absent, consented_at set) AND the client is CLEARED in docs/permission-register.yaml.

harvested_record.description: The intake record produced. Names the client only when client_named is true; otherwise every client-identifying token is redacted from every field.

pass.description: True only when no gating violation (consent-revoked, consent-missing, uncleared-client-reference) was raised.
